data.title: Read the HOA CC&Rs before you buy
data.body: Half of my HOA cases start with "nobody told me". The CC&Rs are public and you can read them before closing. Fence heights, paint colors, rentals: it is all in there. #realestate #hoa #homebuying

data.title: Fired after complaining? Write the timeline today.
data.body: Retaliation cases are won on timelines. Write down every date: when you complained, to whom, what happened next. Save emails to a personal account before you lose access. #employmentlaw #retaliation #wrongfultermination

data.title: NYC tenants: your deposit must be returned in 14 days
data.body: Since 2019 New York landlords must return your security deposit, with an itemized statement for any deductions, within 14 days of move-out. Miss the deadline and they forfeit the right to keep any of it. #tenantrights #nyc #housing

data.title: Why an operating agreement matters even for one owner
data.body: A single-member LLC without an operating agreement is easier to pierce in court. Twenty pages, one afternoon, and your personal assets are far safer. #smallbusiness #llc #startups

data.title: Points vs. fines: what a speeding ticket really costs
data.body: The fine is the small part. Points raise your insurance for three years, and in Colorado 12 points in 12 months means a suspension. Fighting the ticket is usually cheaper than paying it. #trafficticket #speeding #drivingtips

data.title: A debt collector must prove they own the debt
data.body: When a collector sues, make them show the chain of title. Many cannot. Request validation in writing within 30 days of the first letter. #debt #consumerrights #garnishment
